prompt: Soft side light slowly brightens across the closed wooden chest and its tied cord, dust motes float in the beam, everything else still. The lid stays shut. Restraint and dignity - what you heard stays with you. Static camera, a very slow push-in. Keep every object exactly as in the image, nothing added or removed. No people, no hands, no faces, no creatures, no moon, no text.
